An '''apartment complex''' in the [[Blastfield Shipyards]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] was the site of a battle between two [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], [[Unaw Aharo]] and the [[Hero of Tython]], and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] when it was discovered that the building's occupants were sheltering Aharo.
